content: {"praised":["Intricate characters and unexpected twists keep viewers engaged.","Elegant, stylish tone reminiscent of classic Hollywood glamour.","Fun, beautiful entertainment with mystery and romance.","Strong performances by Angelina Jolie and Johnny Depp.","Sophisticated, adult storytelling with humor and sex appeal."],"criticized":["Poor pacing leads to a dull, unengaging experience.","Acting lacks range, especially Angelina Jolie’s performance.","Film feels boring and disappointing despite star power.","Grungy, unappealing character portrayal detracts from story.","Overall lack of excitement and momentum."]}
